svg.aria-label: The executable construction of A-contrast-memory-spherical-v1: hardware and software
svg.text: The executable construction of A-contrast-memory-spherical-v1: hardware and software
Hardware: cells of twelve ports, their seams, the sphere of cells and the registers. Software: two laws under test, a cage of the second, the instruments of an observer, its clock and its records.
A Universe that computes its own history
A brain that thinks itself into existence
The Universe is a network of very simple observers. Each holds
a few records and compares them with its neighbours. What
survives every comparison is a public fact. The observers inside
work out the rules and build the machine whose run is this same
history, its builders included. Nothing stands outside the loop.

text.font-family: Menlo, Consolas, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: Why this problem can be solved
A consistent history is a fixed point: every record agrees with every
record it overlaps. A search through all histories grows exponentially.
The observers do not search. Each repairs what it shares with one
neighbour, and every accepted repair lowers the total disagreement by
a fixed step. The work is bounded by the disagreement at the start:
polynomial in the number of ports.
Proved for the native repair of the theory, with loads bounded by the alphabet.
For the two candidate laws tested here it is the target, and work in progress.
The carriers of the tests: 20, 80 and 320 cells.
The screen of the Universe we inhabit: about
8 × 10¹²² cells in the count of the theory.
One kind of cell, one wiring, one law on every seam,
the star of port 0: its five seams
a wedge: two seams at one port

svg.text: Twelve ports on an icosahedron: one kind of port, one
kind of seam, the largest symmetry twelve points allow.
Its six axes span three directions, and the slowest
response of the cell has rank three.
Blue lines: the five seams of port 0. Dashed lines lie on the far side.
The labels 0 to 11 are those of the carrier files; every table of the manual uses them.
What sits on a port, a seam and a wedge
Law 1: loads with a seam memory
private memory of the seam: blank, or one of ten records (c, x)
x: the difference of the two loads that was written. c: the coin of an odd total.
a reference register at zero on
every port with five seams, so that
a reader of eleven bits per seam
Law 2: one mode on every seam and on every wedge

svg.text: Each mode holds one object at most. An object on a seam moves through a wedge to the next seam of the same port.
The federation: cells on a sphere, one seam between neighbouring cells
Every dot is one whole cell of twelve ports. Every orange line is one external seam: it joins one port of a cell to one port of a neighbour.
A cell sits on a triangle of the sphere and has three neighbours. Each refinement cuts every triangle into four: 20, 80, 320 cells.
Filled dots: the three external ports of the cell lie symmetrically (pairwise two seams apart). Open dots: the gluing rule chose an unsymmetric triple.
Gluing rule of the builder (a declared convention): the external seam towards a neighbour leaves through the port whose direction, in the
local frame of the cell, points most nearly at that neighbour; two seams never share a port. A port therefore has five or six seams.
Why a sphere: the theory places observers on a closed screen. Why refinement: a result has to hold as the cells get finer.
The wiring between two cells of the 20-cell carrier
one external seam: port 3 of cell 0 to port 0 of cell 4
yellow ports carry the external seams of each cell; dotted stubs lead to the other neighbours

svg.text: with the memory blank: h_e = (1 − SWAP_e)/2 + κ (n_a − n_b)²
the number of loads, and how many ports hold one load and how many hold two
for every seam: whether its memory is blank, and the size |x| of a record it holds
Particle stability: a pair written on a seam is read as a pair with probability
at least 1 − 40/(2κ − 6)² for κ > 3, at every size of the carrier and at every time.
An unrecovered seam: a memory that holds a record while its ports are empty
stays that way. It holds no load and lies κ above a blank seam.
As events: every seam acts once per round by exp(−i τ h_e); each port observer counts its own rounds.
Supplied: the coupling κ (8 and 128 in the runs), the emitter that writes a pair, the reader. Candidate: A-contrast-memory-spherical-v1.

svg.text: H = H₀ + 1024 Σ_ports (1 − P_b) + 512 Σ_loops (P_S − C_l) + 1024 Σ_unused (1 − |0⟩⟨0|)
432 two-state registers: 120 transit bits, 120 bits of the port codes, 192 apparatus bits;
259 loop constraints keep the registers a faithful picture of objects that exclude each other;
a broken code or loop costs 1024, far above every level of the law.
The lines of an added object are read at 1.0000, 1.5435, 2.0000, 2.1490 of the observer’s own
reference, predicted from spatial comparisons before the records exist (one cell).
A created object costs at least m, holds no charge of the twelve currents, and its number is kept.
On the sphere: round seam terms D = [[m, G B T], [T Bᵀ G, −m]] give the levels of a round sphere.
A cage in the flat branch swings after a pulse and is kept; see the next panel.
Supplied: m = 1, pulses, ramps, apparatus bits. Candidates: A-scalar-CAR-pair-transit-v2, A-native-scalar-overlap-v3, the round sibling.
A cage in the flat branch of law 2: a ring of four seams, its swing and its persistence
At each port of the ring a plus meets a minus:
the port passes nothing on to its other seams.

The swing after a finite pulse

svg.text: P_e = 1 − (σ²/E²) sin²(E t): a constant and one line at 2E
The pulse H − 2E n(e), for π / (2 √(2E(E − m))), puts the object of the
lower mode on e and does the work 3.456. Then no drive: the record
starts from rest and swings. The reference alone does not swing.

svg.text: four settings θ = 0, π/2, π, 3π/2 turn the differences into one complex number per count q; its spectrum over q shows the frequencies in units of the observer’s reference
Ports, seams and cells are the hardware of a computation. They are no space. What is compared with nature is what the observers record and agree on.
No observer reads the state of the program, its evolution parameter or a common clock; two observers compare clocks through the records on their overlap.
Both laws are candidates under test. Law 1 is specified in model/contrast_memory_spherical_v1/SPEC.md; the package for law 2 is model/scalar_channel, with the cage in model/scalar_channel/cage.
